cohort: Women who delivered between January 1, 2021 and December 31, 2021 at a tertiary care hospital in West Bengal, India.
finding: The highest cesarean section rates were seen in Robson's group 9 (abnormal lie), group 6 (breech nulliparous), and group 5 (previous cesarean section), with group 5 contributing the most to the overall cesarean section rate.
